notes.title: UT Update 3.0
notes.content:
[h1]🔧 Technical Update & Quality of Life Improvements
--------------------------------------------------------[/h1]

[h2]📡 Server Migration[/h2]

Last week, I migrated my personal server and discovered that some game assets (videos, images, and a PHP scripts) were still hosted on a friend's server for this game. This update was done to address the migration of these assets to the new server and updates the corresponding in-game links.


[h2]✨ Quality of Life Changes[/h2]

    🔋 Energy regeneration time reduced from 10 minutes to 1 minute
    🎴 Card slot 2 requirement lowered from level 50 to level 10
    🎴 Card slot 3 requirement lowered from level 100 to level 20
    🚫 Removed the 2 unused areas requiring 99 stars (since these won't be added in the near future)

These changes should make the game at least a bit more enjoyable and allow for continuous play without waiting or making purchases for those who still want it!


[h2]💭 A Note About the Future[/h2]

I know some of you might have been hoping for new content, and I understand - the game has been pretty much dead and abandoned for the past 4-5 years. While I can't make any promises, there is a slight possibility that I might return to completely revamp the game in the future. Currently, I'm focused on various non-game projects, but I still care about providing the best possible experience with the existing content.

Thank you for your continued support and understanding. 
Have a great day! 🌟

notes.title: Easter Update Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We just released the new Easter Update Event.
[i][b]To access the new event, you only need 5 stars[/b][/i] 

You can then visit the Airport on the Main City Map and select the Easter Island Event.

Along with the Event, we added a button to review the story directly from the Gallery Page.

We also added new Events button on both the Gallery and Inventory.

Remember, the game is odds based, yet if you fail repeatedly, your odds of winning increase each time. Take a break and come back later and you will win eventually.

Thank you for your support and have a great Easter Vacations everyone!

notes.title: New Update is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[b]Madison[/b] and [b]Kristi[/b] are now both available for you to fight in the market district. They are unlocked after completing the story part with Erin.

We are still working on more content but wanted to get this one out as soon as it was ready for those who have managed to complete everything so far.

Thank you everyone and have a great day!

notes.title: Name Change Update now Available
notes.content:
We have received a few messages from people wanting to change their name because their Steam username did not work well in the game.

We are happy to announce that we have just added the feature in the option menu. You can now manually enter any name you like for your character, simply tick the checkbox and the name entered will be used instead of your Steam username.

If you have other suggestion or would like to suggest improvements, feel free to message us at support@undresstournament.com

We are working on more content and new features which will be available soon.
